subject: Next steps & procurement framing — Redwood for Novus HealthTech
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@novushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & procurement framing — Redwood for Novus HealthTech

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned. I wanted to make sure we captured the pain, success criteria, and the procurement path before we loop in legal/procurement formally.

Pain points you shared
- Clinical teams are spending ~8–12 hours/week manually triaging patient notes for coding exceptions; accuracy drops with noisy EHR text.
- Current homegrown model has high variance and unpredictable latency at scale.
- Tight data residency / audit requirements for PHI processing.

Current stack
- EHR: Epic; pre-processing: internal Python pipeline; model: in-house fine-tuned transformer (CPU inference behind a queue).
- On-prem data retention and SIEM integration required for audit logs.

Success criteria (what you told us)
1) Reduce triage time by >=40% across pilot workload.
2) Median inference latency <150ms for single-record calls when under pilot load.
3) Clear audit logs and SOC2-like evidence for the pilot scope.

Procurement & decision process (as discussed)
- Primary decision owner: Alyssa Turner (Clinical Ops).
- Procurement lead: Evan Liu (Procurement) — expects an initial commercial review + standard PO / SOW path.
- Legal: Novus legal will need a standard data processing addendum; timeline target: internal approvals in 3–4 weeks if pilot terms are standard.

Initial commercial guardrails (we proposed)
- Pilot term: 8 weeks, capped to 100k tokens/month (estimate) with a fixed pilot fee.
- If pilot succeeds, propose a phased Dedicated reservation + per-token overage.
- We can offer a limited pilot discount and an SLA uplift for Dedicated in scope of production rollout.

Attachments I’m sharing
- SOW-draft-novus-pilot-v1.pdf (pilot scope + acceptance criteria)
- pricing-estimate-novus.csv (pilot fee & post-pilot illustrative pricing)
- security-quickpack.pdf (SOC2 summary + audit artifacts we can provide)

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll share the SOW and pricing (attached) — please review by Thu 8/12.
2) Can you confirm Evan (procurement) as the person who will handle the PO/SOW?
3) If that’s correct, we’ll loop in our deals team and legal to prepare a pilot SOW + DPA template for Novus review.
4) Optional: a short tech deep-dive with Laura and your infra/security lead to confirm logging and network constraints (20–30m).

If helpful I can also send a short one-pager that maps success criteria to measurable telemetry (latency, per-record accuracy, audit logs).

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: SOW-draft-novus-pilot-v1.pdf (pdf), pricing-estimate-novus.csv (csv), security-quickpack.pdf (pdf)

From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@novushealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & procurement framing — Redwood for Novus HealthTech

Thanks Ben — this is a helpful recap and lines up with what we discussed. A few notes from our side: 

- Pain & success criteria: confirmed. Clinical leadership wants a clear definition of "reduced triage time" — we can provide baseline metrics for the pilot next day.
- Procurement: Evan will be the PO owner; he asked that any pilot invoice be under $25k to speed approvals.
- Legal: we will need a DPA + security questionnaire answers. I see you included a quickpack; Evan will still have the standard questionnaire PDF.
- Timeline: if we get SOW + pilot fee numbers by Thursday, I can get procurement engaged the following Monday. That keeps us on a 3–4 week internal approval cadence.

Questions for Redwood to confirm: 
1) Can the pilot be limited to a subset of clinics (we proposed 5 clinics) with the same per-token cap?
2) Are you able to provide an initial performance SLA for the pilot window (not production SLA, but a pilot target we can measure against)?

Looping Evan — Evan, are you ok taking the PO lead? Also looping in Raj (infra) privately for a tech sync if needed.

—Alyssa
Alyssa Turner
Director, Clinical Operations | Novus HealthTech
alyssa.turner@novushealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@novushealth.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@novushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & procurement framing — Redwood for Novus HealthTech

Alyssa / Evan — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Short answers and next actions: 

1) Clinic subset: yes — pilot scoped to 5 clinics is fine. We will reflect that in the SOW and token cap.

2) Pilot SLA: we can commit to a pilot target of median inference latency <150ms for single-record calls (measured on requests routed to Redwood-hosted pilot endpoints under the capped pilot load). We’ll include measurement methodology in the SOW acceptance criteria.

Commercial guardrails (confirming)
- Pilot fee: $19,500 (fixed) for the 8-week pilot; token cap: 100k tokens/month; overages billed at the pilot per-token rate by month.
- Invoice: we can issue a pilot invoice under $25k to align with Evan’s approval threshold (Ben note: this should help speed PO).
- Post-pilot: we’ll propose a phased Reserved (Dedicated) plan with a 3-month ramp and an optional enterprise SLA.

Action items assigned
- Ben: Circulate final SOW + pricing (final attached SOW-draft-novus-pilot-v2.pdf & pricing-estimate-novus.csv) by end of day today.
- Laura: Schedule a 30m tech sync with Raj (and Novus infra/security) — Laura will reach out separately.
- Evan: Confirm PO owner and the procurement information we should put on the invoice (billing contact, PO number process).
- Alyssa: Send baseline triage metrics when available so we can lock acceptance criteria.

Related links
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1348123/rdw-2026-0957
- Shared SOW (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSOWnovus
- DocuSign template (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/templates/abcd-1234

If that all looks good, we’ll treat this as an actionable pilot and start executing on the SOW + tech sync. Thanks again — excited to move forward.

Ben
